features.description:
Bounded re-run of the live cross-vendor goal-audit dogfood against an enriched Plan G mirror fixture. Single feature: enrich the fixture per D001 (fair source coverage + runtime-like artifacts), perform exactly ONE live codex invocation per D002, parse the envelope (parser fix from commit `080b907` should produce `agree`/`disagree`, NOT `dispatch_response_malformed`), classify codex findings through Plan 003's 4-bucket taxonomy (D005), and exercise the close/override path on real parsed findings (D007).

## Fixture enrichment scope (D001)

The parent dogfood (Plan 003) closed with three fixture-fairness findings (E008 + auditor-overlay-001 + auditor-overlay-002) flagging that:
- not every adapter source was present in the mirror;
- the no-test-orchestration invariant requires source-level evidence not just tests;
- the runtime-evidence harness needs runtime-like artifacts not only code/test/memo files.

F001 enriches the existing `evidence/g-mirror/synthetic-plan/` mirror (carried forward from Plan 003 commit `616ad94`) by adding ONLY:

1. **Adapter / source modules** (copy under fixture-plan's evidence path):
   - `web.py`, `ios.py`, `android.py`, `backend.py`, `harness.py` from `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/runtime_evidence/`
   - any minimal config / shared base modules required to interpret them (e.g. `__init__.py` if it carries shared types)
   The bar is "fair representation of the Plan G surface as a cross-vendor auditor would expect to see it," not exhaustive shipping of `runtime_evidence/`.

2. **Runtime-like artifacts per source** (synthesize stubs if no real session capture exists; operator pre-approved stub-quality):
   - **web** — screenshot.png (placeholder), dom-dump.html, console.json, network.har
   - **ios** — screenshot.png (placeholder), log-slice.txt, crash-marker.txt (or no-crash.txt)
   - **android** — screenshot.png (placeholder), logcat-slice.txt, tombstone-marker.txt (or no-tombstone.txt)
   - **backend** — log.jsonl request sample, response.jsonl sample
   - **harness** — at minimum a runner-output.txt or similar invocation artifact

3. **Plan G read-only invariant** — Plan G's plan dir stays untouched. Artifacts are COPIED into this plan's evidence fixture, never moved or symlinked.

## What is NOT enriched

- The fixture's `objective_contract.json` `required_evidence` matchers — byte-identical to Plan 003's. NO matcher tuning. (Operator: "Do not tune matchers to force pass.")
- The fixture's plan.md / features.json / decisions.jsonl shape — these stay the same retrospective ObjectiveContract framing Plan 003 locked.

## Live codex invocation (D002)

Exactly ONE invocation. Path: `dontpanic plan audit docs/plans/2026-05-07-002-.../evidence/g-mirror/synthetic-plan/`. Captures envelope at the standard `audit-codex-1.json` location AND transcript at `audit-codex-1.transcript.txt`. Token cost recorded in close-out memo for cost-discipline trail.

## Parser fix verification (acceptance #4)

With parser fix `080b907` in tree, envelope.status MUST be in {`agree`, `disagree`}. If it is `dispatch_response_malformed`, D007 escape clause fires: STOP, surface a new D-entry recording the unexpected format, and do NOT close the plan. (Expected not to fire — parser tests cover the dogfood transcript shape directly.)

## Finding classification (D005)

Each `findings_dispositions[i]` is classified through the 4-bucket taxonomy carried forward from Plan 003 D005:
- **(a) real platform issue** → queued follow-up plan; in-plan F2 patch ONLY if tiny + operator-approved.
- **(b) prompt-tuning gap** → queued follow-up plan; in-plan prompt edit forbidden.
- **(c) spec-clarification** → record + dismiss.
- **(d) false-positive** → record + dismiss.

Per-finding decision recorded in decisions.jsonl with explicit tag.

## Close path (D007)

- envelope `agree` → close without override (suspicious if first run; investigate before accepting).
- envelope `disagree` with all (c)/(d) → close with override, reason = classified findings summary, all 4 D004 hashes recorded.
- envelope `disagree` with any (a)/(b) → close with override, reason = follow-up plan citation, all 4 D004 hashes recorded.
- envelope `dispatch_response_malformed` → STOP, escalate, no flip.

The override path is exercised, not avoided. The plan's value is the recorded honest decision.
steps: Pre-flight: confirm parser-fix commit `080b907` is in tree (`git log --oneline 080b907`); confirm cumulative orchestrate suite still 1357 passed (smoke); confirm Plan G + Plan 003 + parser plan dirs are untouched.

Build enriched fixture per D001 by extending Plan 003's existing `synthetic-plan/` mirror. Copy mirror skeleton (plan.md, features.json, decisions.jsonl, objective_contract.json) verbatim from Plan 003's `evidence/g-mirror/synthetic-plan/` into this plan's `evidence/g-mirror/synthetic-plan/`. Verify byte-identical `objective_contract.json.required_evidence` against Plan 003 (no matcher tuning per acceptance #2).

Add adapter / source modules per D001 category 1: copy `web.py`, `ios.py`, `android.py`, `backend.py`, `harness.py` (and minimal shared `__init__.py` / base modules) from `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/runtime_evidence/` into the fixture under a path the auditor's evidence-manifest builder can reach. Document chosen path in this plan's decisions.jsonl.

Add runtime-like artifacts per D001 category 2: per-source synthesize stubs (screenshot placeholders, log slices, console/dom/network samples, JSONL backend samples, harness runner output). Stub-quality acceptable; operator pre-approved.
Re-validate the fixture-plan against agent-conventions v1.0 schemas (`python3 claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/validate.py docs/plans/2026-05-07-002-.../evidence/g-mirror/synthetic-plan/`).

Sanity check: run `dontpanic plan audit <fixture-plan>` with `DONTPANIC_GOAL_AUDITOR_OFFLINE=1` to verify the plumbing without burning a live invocation. Capture the synthetic envelope; assert status='dispatch_skipped_offline'. Restore env after.

**Single live codex invocation (D002):** unset OFFLINE env; run `dontpanic plan audit <fixture-plan>` against the production path. Capture envelope at `audit-codex-1.json` + transcript at `audit-codex-1.transcript.txt`. Record token-cost numbers from transcript footer for cost-discipline trail.
Verify acceptance #4 (parser fix): assert `envelope.status in {'agree','disagree'}`. If `dispatch_response_malformed`, D007 escape clause: STOP, file new D-entry, do NOT close.
Verify acceptance #5 (cross-vendor invariant D003): assert `envelope.auditor_agent == 'codex'` AND `envelope.implementer_agent == 'claude'` AND `DONTPANIC_GOAL_AUDITOR_ALLOW_SAME_VENDOR` was unset.

Classify each `findings_dispositions[i]` through D005's 4-bucket taxonomy. Record per-finding (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) decision with rationale in decisions.jsonl. For (a) findings → file follow-up plan slug in close-out memo; for (b) → file follow-up; for (c)/(d) → record dismissal rationale.

Choose close path per D007 based on parsed envelope status + finding classifications. Execute: either `dontpanic plan close <fixture-plan>` (if agree) OR `dontpanic plan close <fixture-plan> --ignore-completion-findings <reason>` (if disagree). Verify envelope-bound override.json carries all 4 D004 hashes (features + objective_contract + completion_findings + evidence_manifest).

Verify worktree boundary D004: `git diff --name-only HEAD` confined to `docs/plans/2026-05-07-002-…/`. Zero diffs to F1/F2 module code, runtime_evidence/, executors/, cli.py, supervisor.py, prompt template, agent-conventions schemas, parent plan dirs, tests/, or `tests/fixtures/`.
Run cumulative orchestrate suite (smoke): expect 1357 passed (unchanged from parser plan close baseline). Run ruff check / format on touched files (none expected); run sanitization_check.py.
Append D-entry to decisions.jsonl recording: ship metadata + commit hash + envelope status + per-finding 4-bucket classifications + chosen close path + cited follow-up plans (if any).
Flip F001 passes:true with evidence_refs (commit hash + fixture artifacts + envelope.json + transcript + override.json if used + close-out memo + decisions D-entry).
Author `evidence/plan-closeout-memo.md` with verification numbers, envelope shape, classified findings table, chosen close path, queued follow-ups (if any), token-cost summary.
Run outer plan close via exempt-plan flow: `dontpanic plan close docs/plans/2026-05-07-002-fix-cross-vendor-dogfood-fixture-runtime-artifacts/`. Expect exit 0, status flipped active → completed.

Commit (one local commit) covering: enriched fixture + envelope + transcript + override.json (if used) + close-out memo + decisions D-entries + features.json passes:true. NO module / test / fixture / prompt edits.
features.acceptance: (1) Fixture enrichment bounded by D001 — only the three categories (adapter sources + runtime-like artifacts + read-only Plan G provenance). NO additions outside those categories. (2) NO matcher tuning — fixture `objective_contract.json` `required_evidence` byte-identical to Plan 003's. (3) Exactly ONE live codex invocation (D002), recorded with transcript filename + token cost numbers in close-out memo. NO additional invocations without explicit operator approval. (4) Parser fix verified at envelope level — `envelope.status ∈ {'agree', 'disagree'}`, NOT `dispatch_response_malformed`. If malformed, D007 escape fires (STOP, escalate, no flip). (5) Cross-vendor invariant verified at envelope level (D003) — `envelope.auditor_agent == 'codex'` AND `envelope.implementer_agent == 'claude'` AND no `DONTPANIC_GOAL_AUDITOR_ALLOW_SAME_VENDOR` set. (6) Each `findings_dispositions[i]` classified through D005's 4-bucket taxonomy with explicit (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) tag in decisions.jsonl. (7) Close path exercised end-to-end (D007): operator-judged path (without override / with override) recorded in close-out memo; override.json (if used) carries all 4 D004 hashes. (8) Worktree boundary D004 preserved — diff confined to this plan dir. Zero diffs to F1/F2 module code, runtime_evidence/, executors/, cli.py, supervisor.py, agent-conventions schemas, prompt template, parent plan dirs, tests/, tests/fixtures/. (9) NO module / test / fixture-file / prompt edits in this plan. F2 patches forbidden by default; tiny-fix release valve requires explicit operator approval before edit. (10) Cumulative orchestrate suite stays green at the 1357-passed baseline (no module changes → no regression risk; smoke-checked anyway). (11) Plan-level close via exempt-plan flow (`goal_type=infra`) exits 0; supervisor backstop silent on the post-close plan. (12) Close-out memo + D-entry appended.
